name: Runs on Runtime
description: This directory site itself — a static site running python/nginx listing repos that run on Aiven Runtime.

name: MCP and Proxy
description: POC for a MCP server behind a proxy so that it can scale horizontally as well as vertically.

name: Apache Kafka® Streams
description: Examples of logging, copying and filtering (copying and altering) Apache Avro® messages, using Apache Kafka® streams and a schema registry.Kafka Streams is the standard library to use when taking data from one Kafka topic and writing an amended version to another, in real time. It is written in Java and kept up to date with Kafka itself.

name: Type text, find pictures, using CLIP, PostgreSQL® and pgvector
description: Uses the OpenAI CLIP model to generate embeddings for a pre-prepared selection of images, and stores them in PostgreSQL with pgvector. A web app lets the user enter a phrase, the CLIP model generates its embedding, and an SQL query is used to find the four images with the closest embedding to the text, which are shown to the user.
